message.content: {"mechanism_id":"success-magnitude-gated-memory","target_component":"SHADE memory update (M_F, M_CR) and archive insertion","observed_evidence":{"task_id":"TASK-06","trace_path":"diagnostic_trace_summary","function":"F10","seed":11,"metric":"late_success_rate_vs_best_raw","observed_value":0.617},"causal_hypothesis":"On high-conditioning F10, many accepted trials yield tiny relative fitness gains; these trivial successes still feed |delta_f| weights into Lehmer/arithmetic memory updates and archive, biasing F/CR toward exploitative values that stagnate best_raw.","algorithmic_change":"Weight memory updates and archive insertion by a normalized improvement magnitude g = (parent_fit - trial_fit)/(|parent_fit| + eps), and only count a success toward memory when g exceeds a running median threshold tau; trivial successes update nothing.","mathematical_rule":"g_i = (f_parent - f_trial) / (|f_parent| + 1e-12); tau = median(g over last W=50 accepted trials); if g_i > tau: w_i = g_i else w_i = 0; M_F = sum(w_i * F_i^2) / sum(w_i * F_i); M_CR = sum(w_i * CR_i) / sum(w_i); archive insert only if g_i > tau.","expected_effect":"Memory and archive reflect only meaningful improvements, reducing late trivial-success inflation and lowering best_raw on F10 while preserving genuine progress.","failure_prediction":"If tau drifts too high early (few accepted trials), memory starves and F/CR freeze; on unimodal easy functions the gate may discard useful small steps and slow convergence.","ablation_plan":"Compare (a) full gate, (b) gate on memory only, (c) gate on archive only, (d) no gate, across F10 seeds 11-55; report best_raw and late success rate.","nearest_known_methods":"SHADE weighted memory by |delta_f|; success-history adaptation; threshold-based archive filtering.","implementation_requirements":"Track rolling window of last 50 accepted g values; compute median each acceptance; modify memory update and archive insert conditionally; eps guard for zero parent fitness."}
